info.title: AnxietyWatch Client API
info.description: Versioned contract for the thin Apple client; registry identifiers remain in registry.json

post.summary: Claim an operator-created enrollment artifact and issue a scoped public-key credential.
post.description:
The request is intentionally not signed: the single-use artifact is the enrollment proof and
is transported only to the configured origin. The database transaction consumes the artifact
and inserts the credential together, so a lost response cannot make the artifact reusable.

# Errors

Returns a named version, validation, database, or consumed-artifact blocker.

post.summary: Authenticate and process a bounded batch of domain-record or platform-sample writes.
post.description:
# Errors

Returns a version, authentication, body, or persistence error. Individual record validation and
idempotency outcomes are returned as item acknowledgements.

403.description: Credential scope does not permit this operation

409.description: Durable request id was already admitted

post.summary: Admit a client-observed display or acknowledgement fact without inferring provider delivery.
post.description:
# Errors

Returns a named version, authentication, or unavailable-ledger blocker.

409.description: Durable request id was already admitted

post.summary: Admit authenticated APNs registration facts from an enrolled iPhone.
post.description:
# Errors

Returns a named version, authentication, validation, configuration, or persistence blocker.

409.description: Durable request id was already admitted

503.description: Registration persistence or token protection unavailable

get.summary: Returns a version error or the authenticated projection page.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns a named error for incompatible versions, failed request authentication, invalid
registry metrics or windows, unavailable storage, or a failed projection query.

403.description: Credential scope does not permit this operation

409.description: Durable request id was already admitted

get.summary: Return registry JSON exactly as generated, wrapped with its digest.
get.description:
# Errors

Returns a stable error for a missing/malformed/incompatible API version or malformed generated
registry JSON.

post.summary: Accept an authenticated, idempotent operational phone status beacon.
post.description:
# Errors

Returns a named version, authentication, validation, conflict, or persistence error.

403.description: Credential scope does not permit this operation

409.description: Durable request or beacon id was already admitted

ApnsOutcomeRequest.description: Client-observed APNs display or acknowledgement fact.

device_id.description: Authenticated device identity; must equal the signed client id.

environment.description: APNs environment selected by the signed app build.

token.description: Lowercase hexadecimal APNs token, absent when iOS has not supplied one.

ClientAuthHeaders.description: RFC 9421 request-authentication fields fixed by Amendment 09.

content_digest.description: RFC 9530 digest of the request body.

request_id.description: Fresh UUID for durable replay rejection.

api_version.description: API version of this error envelope.

blocker.description: Named capability, task, version, or value that blocked the operation.

message.description: Human-readable error summary without sensitive payload content.

requested_major.description: Client-requested major when one was supplied.

retryable.description: Whether retrying later without user action may progress.

ClientVersionResponse.description: API compatibility response. This endpoint is safe before enrollment.

api_version.description: Contract version implemented by this server.

minimum_client_major.description: Oldest client major accepted for writes.

ClientWriteBatch.description: A bounded batch of credential-neutral outbox items.

recorded_at.description: Instant the client formed the batch, distinct from item subject time.

ClientWriteItem.description: One immutable outbox item. Class remains a string so unknown future classes survive decoding.

class.description: Open item class owned by the server contracts.

content.description: Class-specific payload; never a precomputed request signature.

ClientWriteResponse.description: Future item-level write result. HTTP success alone never deletes outbox payloads.

acknowledgements.description: One terminal or retryable outcome per submitted item.

api_version.description: API contract version that processed the batch.

batch_id.description: Batch identifier copied from the request.

EnrollmentClaimRequest.description: Future one-time enrollment claim. Unknown JSON fields are intentionally ignored.

api_major.description: API major from the enrollment artifact.

app_version.description: Client build string for compatibility evidence.

public_key_spki_der_b64.description: P-256 public key encoded as SPKI DER and then base64.

server_instance_id.description: Stable server instance expected by the artifact.

EnrollmentCredentialResponse.description: Future successful enrollment result, included as a shared schema but not advertised as success.

api_version.description: API contract version that issued the credential.

key_id.description: Identifier of the enrolled public key.

HealthBeaconRequest.description: Operational phone evidence; it carries no measurement value.

asserted_at.description: Instant at which the phone made the assertion.

beacon_id.description: Client-minted idempotency identifier for this assertion.

changed_at.description: Last time the phone changed any reported status fact.

last_server_ack_at.description: Most recent item-level server acknowledgement instant.

oldest_outbox_age_s.description: Age of the oldest unacknowledged item, when one exists.

registry_sha256.description: Digest of the registry used by the client.

api_version.description: API contract version that processed the beacon.

beacon_id.description: Client idempotency identifier copied from the request.

status.description: `accepted` for a new assertion or `replayed` for identical content.

HealthKitBatchPayload.description:
A bounded anchored-query envelope. Samples and deletion facts are committed together by the
authenticated receiver; an empty envelope is not sent by the phone.

deletions.description: Deletion facts in this query page.

samples.description: Source samples in this query page.

HealthKitDeletionPayload.description: A `HealthKit` deletion fact. The server records a tombstone and never deletes a sample row.

HealthKitSamplePayload.description: One source sample as sent by the Apple client.

fixture.description: Synthetic-fixture marker, ignored by the mapper.

original_category.description: Original `HealthKit` category value, present for category samples.

original_unit.description: Original `HealthKit` unit identifier, present for quantity samples.

original_value.description: Original numeric value, present for quantity samples.

query_batch_id.description: Client batch identity from the query or observer operation.

record_id.description: Client item identity, validated by the outer receiver.

recorded_at.description: Instant at which the phone recorded the item.

HealthTypeFact.description: Independent facts for one `HealthKit` identifier; no field claims read access was granted.

authorization_request_outcome.description: Outcome of requesting authorization; never a claim that read access is granted.

background_delivery_outcome.description: Outcome of requesting iOS background delivery.

configured.description: Whether this type is enabled in client settings.

healthkit_type.description: Original `HealthKit` type identifier, not a generated physiological enum.

last_matching_sample_at.description: Last matching `HealthKit` sample instant, when observed.

last_pi_ack_at.description: Last Pi item acknowledgement for this type.

ItemAcknowledgement.description: One item outcome. `status` is open for forward-compatible unknown values.

code.description: Stable machine-readable reason when status needs detail.

retryable.description: Whether a later transport attempt may make progress.

status.description: Open status; current values include created, replayed, rejected, conflict, and retryable.

ProjectionPage.description: Future server projection page, included for fixture compatibility only.

api_version.description: API contract version carrying the projection.

generated_at.description: Instant at which the Pi generated this projection.

missing_intervals.description: UTC start/end pairs naming missing coverage.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page.

observed_at.description: Most recent source observation represented, when one exists.

points.description: Projection points with explicit null values for gaps.

ProjectionPoint.description: Missing physiological data is represented by `null`, never zero or interpolation.

value.description: Server-projected value, or null when not measured.

ProjectionQuery.description: Projection query uses UTC windows and an opaque server cursor.

RegistryDiscoveryResponse.description: Registry discovery wraps the generated JSON without restating its enums in `OpenAPI`.

api_version.description: API contract version carrying this registry.

document.description: Registry JSON decoded as an open object; identifiers remain registry-owned.

registry_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact generated registry JSON.

SourceRevision.description: `HealthKit` source revision fields retained as sub-provenance.
